m.aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Narasiṁha Hari; victory to you, Lord. Tearing open the pillar, the Lord appeared and took away the suffering of his devotee.
m.aarti.pad1: You are merciful to the lowly, the benefactor of your devotees. Taking a wondrous form, you appeared, the remover of fear.
m.aarti.pad2: You who tear open the hearts of all took the demon's life and slew him. Knowing your devotee to be your servant, you made him your own and showed him grace.
m.aarti.pad3: Brahmā performs the āratī and places a garland on the Lord; Śiva, crying victory, victory, showers flowers.
